subject: Integration acceptance criteria & environment orchestration
body:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration acceptance criteria & environment orchestration

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I captured a lean acceptance checklist so Novacare's infra team can validate the POC environment and we can lock the close timeline. Please review and confirm owners for the rows you control.

High-level acceptance (items we need green to move to contract signatures):
- Org & API access: Redwood org created, two test API keys provisioned (role: dev, read/write limits), key rotation policy noted.
- Network allowlist: Static egress IPs recorded, CSV format attached for your firewall team.
- VPC peering: Peering session established between Novacare staging VPC and Redwood dedicated VPC; routing verification and security groups validated.
- Smoke tests: End-to-end inference against sample payload (<= 400ms p95) and embedding job (batch of 100) completed.
- Audit & logs: Access to request logs and KV cache metrics in console for the trial org.

Proposed immediate owners: Novacare IT for allowlist + peering; Redwood infra (Karthik) for peering config and smoke tests; Mateo for org/API coordination; Stephanie for rollout cadence and legal readiness.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Novacare IT fills the attached network-allowlist-template.csv and returns by Wed 10/21 EOD.
2) Karthik will schedule the peering window once we have the filled CSV and the VPC IDs.
3) Redwood provisions two test API keys and shares them over the secure doc link.
4) We run smoke tests within 48 hours of peering completion and report results.

If that timeline works we can aim for a final acceptance sign-off by Fri 10/29 and then lock in production dates.

Attaching a first draft MAP (2026-10-21_MAP_v1.2.pdf) that maps the milestones to owners and dates.

Best,
Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182


-----Original Message-----
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacare.com>

Cc: Novacare IT Team <it@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration acceptance criteria & environment orchestration

Thanks, Mateo — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We can fill the allowlist CSV but need to coordinate with change window owners; earliest we have is Thu 10/22.
- For VPC peering, Novacare requires a peering request with a CIDR and a target account ID; can you confirm the exact values to include?
- On API key delivery: do you ship keys via DocuSign secure link or should we provide a keyvault endpoint?

I'll loop in our infra lead (cc'd) to coordinate the change window. If we can get the CIDR/account ID today we'll try to fit peering into Thu 10/22 window.

--
Olivia Park
Program Manager, Integrations | Novacare
olivia.park@novacare.com


On Wed, Oct 20, 2026 at 10:45 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Olivia —
>
> Quick answers:
> - CIDR for Redwood dedicated staging: 10.88.0.0/16.
> - Target account ID (peering): 823-114-907.
> - We prefer to deliver API keys via a short-lived secure link (DocuSign or one-time S3 presigned). If you have an internal vault URL we can also push the keys there (SRE-friendly).
>
> Karthik — heads up: Olivia's team has a Thu 10/22 slot for peering if we can supply the filled allowlist + the peering request details today.
>
> Mateo
>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration acceptance criteria & environment orchestration

Hi all —

I can take the peering work. Practical notes for Novacare IT:
- We'll create a peering connection from our side once you confirm your VPC ID and the attached CSV has your egress IPs.
- Routing: please ensure you add a route to 10.88.0.0/16 in the Novacare route table after accept.
- Security groups: by default we open port 443 to the redwood subnet for inference endpoints; if you need additional ports for diagnostics we can add them temporary during the smoke window.
- I'll post the peering CloudFormation snippet into the Drive folder after this email.

I'll be on call Thu 10/22 between 09:00-12:00 PT for the peering window.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com


From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacare.com>

Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration acceptance criteria & environment orchestration

Thanks Karthik, that's perfect.

Novacare IT is confirming our VPC ID (will paste into the CSV). We expect to return the filled allowlist and VPC ID by Thu 10/22 08:30 PT so the peering can be established within your morning window.

Also a note about logging: can you confirm the retention window for request logs during the POC? We need at least 30 days for our compliance team.

Regards,
Olivia
